"Therefore, prioritizing the safety of all attendees, exhibitors, and related parties, as well as ensuring safe return home, we have decided to cancel the event for the entire day."

The TGS showfloor will remain open for today, September 20, with potential modifications.
The game launches November 16, 2026, but you can download the demo right now.
The game is launching into early access February 11, 2027.

Not only did it take no time for even business attendees to start selling the shirts on Japanese auction site Mercari for over 12,000yen each (roughly $76), its first public day saw entry tickets distributed in their entirety for the day almost entirely as a mad dash broke out to secure entry and the t-shirt.
Distribution did resume later that day, but even these have been resold on Mercari for over 6000yen ($38).
